 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-bffb557 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="bffb557" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
 <div class="e-con-inner">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a1ce2ac e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="a1ce2ac" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0a08749 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="0a08749" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <h1>Antony-boy Apartments Small</h1> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-29684c5 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="29684c5" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1d0456a elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="1d0456a" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <div class="c-accommodation-single-header__description js-header-description"><p>Located just steps from the beach, Antony Boy Apartments offer stunning views of the Pelješac Channel and the medieval town of Korčula. Perfect for both a peaceful family getaway and an active holiday, you can enjoy windsurfing, kitesurfing, paragliding, hiking, cycling, sailing — and easy trips to Korčula, Hvar, Dubrovnik, or Mljet National Park.</p></div> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c922592 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="c922592" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">

 </span>
 </a>

 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-12b2f20 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="12b2f20" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
 <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Beachside Comfort in Viganj</h2> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8651425 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="8651425" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <p>Antony Boy apartments are located near the beach and have a beautiful view of the Pelješac channel and the medieval city of Korčula.</p>
<p>This is a perfect location for those seeking a peaceful family vacation to relax on the beautiful Croatian coastline, and for those seeking an active vacation.</p>
<p>Equipped with two bathroom (shower, sink, toilet), fully furnished kitchen (fridge, microwave, Oven) and all the other requisites you need for complete comfort. Each apartment has a satellite TV and free Wi-Fi.“</p> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f43f954 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="f43f954" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <ul>
 <li>Spacious 2 and 3-bedroom apartments</li>
 <li>Terrace with sea view</li>
 <li>100m from the sea</li>
</ul>
Pets welcome </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-875cb2e elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="875cb2e" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <ul><li><strong>Check‑in:</strong> after 14:00 on arrival day</li><li><strong>Check‑out:</strong> by 12:00 on departure day (later stays are billed as an extra</li></ul> </div>
 <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-fdc8b0d elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="fdc8b0d" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
 <p>Arriving after 21:00? No stress—give us a heads‑up and we’ll have someone ready to meet you on‑site and unlock your apartment the moment you roll in.</p> </div>
